name: Pamba
did_you_know: Also called the Dakshina Bhageerathi, or 'Ganga of the South', the Pamba is venerated as one of Kerala's most sacred rivers.
The Sabarimala Temple, one of the most visited pilgrimage sites in India, sits on its banks, and millions of devotees bathe in the river during the annual pilgrimage season.
In its lower course the river splits into several distributary channels before reaching Vembanad Lake, irrigating the low-lying Kuttanad region, parts of which lie below sea level.
